projection.units: km according to DAMIT calibrated-size flag; reconciled to declared equivalent diameter

surfaces.coverage: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. Selected archive volume-equivalent diameter: 144 ±3 km. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. The pinned mesh is an inverse model, not a directly sampled surface. No registered reflectance mosaic is supplied by this release; a neutral grid must mark unavailable imagery. Fine-scale craters, regolith and albedo are unresolved. Absolute rotational phase is illustrative. Select Vernazza et al. (2021) ADAM model 5913 constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. DAMIT D144 ±3 km differs from the publication summary145 ±3 km because the summary can average ADAM/MPCD outputs when coverage exceeds80%; the exact selected mesh has raw volume diameter144.329. Keep the archive ADAM model separate from MPCD refinement. No albedo map is inferred from deconvolved disk images.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
